title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Seahawks D/ST struggles late Sunday
items.desc: The Seahawks D/ST allowed 23 points on 301 total yards with two interceptions, two fumble recoveries and four sacks on Sunday.
items.impact: The Seahawks defense was at its best early in the first half. They struggled a bit more late as the Chargers nearly overcame a 21 point deficit. The Seahawks will face Brock Purdy and the 49ers next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jason Myers makes lone field goal Sunday
items.desc: Jason Myers made his lone field goal attempt and 3-of-4 extra point attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: Myers made his lone field goal from 35 yards out. He missed a 53-yard field goal earlier in the drive, but a leverage penalty on the Chargers gave the Seahawks an automatic first down.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: AJ Barner quiet Sunday
items.desc: AJ Barner caught 1-of-3 targets for 12 yards in the Seahawks 30-23 win over the Chargers.
items.impact: Barner was coming off a big performance last week. He remains a volatile TE2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tory Horton catches touchdown Sunday
items.desc: Tory Horton caught his lone target for a six-yard touchdown in the Seahawks 30-23 win over the Chargers.
items.impact: Horton caught one of the two touchdowns thrown by Sam Darnold. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cooper Kupp quiet Sunday
items.desc: Cooper Kupp caught 1-of-2 targets for 13 yards in the Seahawks 30-23 win over the Chargers.
items.impact: Kupp remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rashid Shaheed scores touchdown on ground Sunday
items.desc: Rashid Shaheed caught 1-of-3 targets for 20 yards in the Seahawks 30-23 win over the Chargers. He also saw two carries for 33 yards and a touchdown.
items.impact: With Jadarian Price on IR, Emanuel Wilson was the workhorse in the Seahawks backfield. Shaheed saw two traditional handoffs from Sam Darnold with one of them resulting in a 28-yard touchdown. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba totals 76 yards Sunday
items.desc: Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught 5-of-6 targets for 76 yards in the Seahawks 30-23 win over the Chargers.
items.impact: It was a quiet day for the standards of Smith-Njigba. Sam Darnold also missed him wide open on multiple plays. He remains a WR1 play next week against the 49ers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: George Holani sees seven carries Sunday
items.desc: George Holani ran for 18 yards on seven carries in the Seahawks 30-23 win over the Chargers.
items.impact: Emanuel Wilson was the workhorse in the Seahawks backfield. Holani remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Emanuel Wilson scores twice Sunday
items.desc: Emanuel Wilson ran for 81 yards and a touchdown on 21 carries in the Seahawks 30-23 win over the Chargers. He also caught 3-of-4 targets for 39 yards receiving and another score.
items.impact: After a fumble on a muffled punt by the Chargers early, Wilson took a screen pass from Sam Darnold to the house for the first score of the day. He was the clear workhorse in the first game since Jadarian Price was placed on IR.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sam Darnold throws two touchdowns Sunday
items.desc: Sam Darnold completed 13-of-22 passes for 168 yards with two touchdowns and one interception in the Seahawks 30-23 win over the Chargers.
items.impact: Darnold threw an interception on the Seahawks first offensive play of the game. He didn't seem to be comfortable in the pocket for most of the afternoon. He'll be a QB2 next week against the 49ers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chargers D/ST records interception Sunday
items.desc: The Chargers D/ST allowed 30 points on 286 total yards with one interception and three sacks on Sunday.
items.impact: The Chargers collected an interception on the Seahawks first offensive play of the game. They will face Bo Nix and the Broncos next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cameron Dicker makes three field goals Sunday
items.desc: Cameron Dicker made 3-of-3 field goals and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: Dicker connected on field goals from 40, 39 and 36 yards out. Despite the Chargers struggles, he remains a steady option for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Oronde Gadsden II catches five passes Sunday
items.desc: Oronde Gadsden II caught 5-of-8 targets for 36 yards in the Chargers 30-23 loss against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Gadsden was a safety blanket for Justin Herbert with his longest reception going for nine yards. He'll be a TE2 play next week against the Broncos.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Quentin Johnston totals 44 yards Sunday
items.desc: Quentin Johnston caught 1-of-2 targets for 44 yards in the Chargers 30-23 loss against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Johnston hauled in one 44 yard pass from Justin Herbert. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tre' Harris totals 60 yards Sunday
items.desc: Tre' Harris caught 3-of-5 targets for 60 yards in the Chargers 30-23 loss against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Harris was the leading receiver for Justin Herbert and the Chargers on the day. He'll be a flex play next week if Ladd McConkey (foot) is sidelined.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ladd McConkey exits early Sunday, goes without a catch
items.desc: Ladd McConkey did not catch either of his two targets before leaving Sunday's game early.
items.impact: McConkey had one drop on what would have been a short reception. He was attempting to play through a foot injury. His status will need to be monitored in practice this upcoming week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kimani Vidal hauls in touchdown Sunday
items.desc: Kimani Vidal ran for 25 yards on five carries in the Chargers 30-23 loss against the Seahawks. He also caught 2-of-3 targets for 11 yards receiving and a score.
items.impact: Vidal caught the lone touchdown pass thrown by Justin Herbert on the day. It was a clear three-man committee in the Chargers backfield on Sunday between him, Omarion Hampton and Keaton Mitchell.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Keaton Mitchell sees 10 carries Sunday
items.desc: Keaton Mitchell ran for 39 yards on 10 carries in the Chargers 30-23 loss against the Seahawks. He also caught 5-of-6 targets for 24 yards receiving.
items.impact: Mitchell saw a team-high 10 carries on the day and 15 touches in total. It was a committee between him, Omarion Hampton and Kimani Vidal on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Omarion Hampton finds the end zone Sunday
items.desc: Omarion Hampton ran for 45 yards and a touchdown on nine carries in the Chargers 30-23 loss against the Seahawks. He also caught 2-of-2 targets for eight yards receiving.
items.impact: Hampton saw just nine carries to 15 combined carries between Keaton Mitchell and Kimani Vidal. Hampton is a touchdown dependent flex play moving forward.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Justin Herbert continues to struggle Sunday
items.desc: Justin Herbert completed 19-of-31 passes for 189 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions in the Chargers 30-23 loss against the Seahawks on Sunday.
items.impact: Herbert added 40 yards rushing on the ground. He threw a pair of interceptions to linebackers, including on the first offensive play of the game. He remains someone tough to trust heading into a matchup against the Broncos next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Texans D/ST struggles Sunday
items.desc: The Texans D/ST allowed 34 points on 399 total yards with three sacks Sunday.
items.impact: Houston had a chance to win its first game of the season with one defensive stop, but they weren't able to get it done. They'll look to bounce back against the Titans next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ka'imi Fairbairn connects on all six kicks Sunday
items.desc: Ka'imi Fairbairn connected on 3-of-3 field goals and extra points on Sunday.
items.impact: Fairbairn made field goals from 51, 39 and 54 yards. He remains a steady option for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dalton Schultz quiet Sunday
items.desc: Dalton Schultz caught 2-of-2 targets for nine yards in the Texans 34-30 loss against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Schultz continues to be less reliable for fantasy managers with Nico Collins on the field.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylin Noel totals 85 yards Sunday
items.desc: Jaylin Noel caught 3-of-3 targets for 85 yards in the Texans 34-30 loss against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Noel had a huge catch of 52 yards downfield from C.J. Stroud. He remains an upside flex play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Hutchinson sees five targets Sunday
items.desc: Xavier Hutchinson caught 3-of-5 targets for 46 yards in the Texans 34-30 loss against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Hutchinson made the most of his playing time despite seeing just 16 snaps. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kayshon Boutte catches three passes Sunday
items.desc: Kayshon Boutte caught 3-of-4 targets for 36 yards in the Texans 34-30 loss against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Boutte remains off the fantasy radar in his current role in the Texans wide receiver room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nico Collins explodes in return Sunday
items.desc: Nico Collins caught 7-of-8 targets for 118 yards and two touchdowns in the Texans 34-30 loss against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Collins picked right up where he left off in his return from injury. He scored the first touchdown of the day for Houston and continued to dominate all afternoon despite the loss. He'll be a WR1 next week against the Titans.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Woody Marks scores again Sunday
items.desc: Woody Marks ran for 22 yards on six carries and a touchdown in the Texans 34-30 loss against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Marks continues to play a role in the Texans backfield next to David Montgomery. Neither of them got much going on the ground. He'll be an upside flex play next week against the Titans.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: David Montgomery shut down Sunday
items.desc: David Montgomery ran for 24 yards on 10 carries in the Texans 34-30 loss against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Montgomery continued his recent struggles on the ground. Woody Marks was the running back to find the end zone again. He'll be a low-end RB2/flex play next week against the Titans.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: C.J. Stroud throws for 347 yards Sunday
items.desc: C.J. Stroud completed 21-of-31 passes for 347 yards with two touchdowns in the Texans 34-30 loss against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Stroud was at his best on Sunday with the return of Nico Collins. He gave the team the lead in the final minutes before the defense wound up blowing it to move to 0-4 on the season. He'll be a QB2 play against the Titans next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cowboys D/ST struggles Sunday
items.desc: The Cowboys D/ST allowed 30 points on 397 total yards with two sacks on Sunday.
items.impact: Dallas was unable to contain Nico Collins in his return on Sunday. They'll take on Jalon Daniels and the Bucs on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brandon Aubrey misses two field goals Sunday
items.desc: Brandon Aubrey made 2-of-4 field goal attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: Aubrey hit a 39 and 50-yard field goal early. He later had a 62-yarder blocked and missed a 65-yard field goal.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jake Ferguson quiet Sunday
items.desc: Jake Ferguson caught 3-of-4 targets for 11 yards in the Cowboys 34-30 win over the Texans.
items.impact: Ferguson spent most of the afternoon blocking against the Texans pass rush. He remains a touchdown dependent tight end on a week-to-week basis.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ryan Flournoy hauls in four passes Sunday
items.desc: Ryan Flournoy caught 4-of-5 targets for 37 yards in the Cowboys 34-30 win over the Texans on Sunday.
items.impact: Flournoy continues to have a limited role in the offense for Dallas. He is a WR4 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: George Pickens totals 75 yards Sunday
items.desc: George Pickens caught 2-of-3 targets for 75 yards in the Cowboys 34-30 win over the Texans.
items.impact: Pickens had a huge 53-yard reception salvage his day. It was the CeeDee Lamb show on Sunday. Pickens remains a WR2 play heading into Thursday's game against the Buccaneers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: CeeDee Lamb hauls in 17 passes Sunday
items.desc: CeeDee Lamb caught 17-of-21 targets for 189 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys 34-30 win over the Texans.
items.impact: Lamb had the go-ahead touchdown with less than 30 seconds left in the game. It was a career day for him getting targeted all throughout the second half. He remains a locked and loaded WR1.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Goodson sees three carries Sunday
items.desc: Tyler Goodson ran for 12 yards on three carries in the Cowboys 34-30 win over the Texans.
items.impact: Javonte Williams remains the clear workhorse in the Cowboys backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Javonte Williams rushes for three touchdowns
items.desc: Javonte Williams ran for 62 yards on 19 carries with three touchdowns in the Cowboys 34-30 win over the Texans. He also caught 5-of-5 targets for 21 yards receiving.
items.impact: Williams didn't have the most efficient day on the ground, but he made up for it with three touchdowns and five receptions. He'll remain an RB1 play on Thursday against the Bucs.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dak Prescott throws for 335 yards Sunday
items.desc: Dak Prescott completed 32-of-45 passes for 335 yards and one touchdown in the Cowboys 34-30 win over the Texans.
items.impact: Prescott exploded in the second half, targeting CeeDee Lamb early and often with the two connecting on 17 catches. Prescott should remain a QB1 play on Thursday against the Buccaneers.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Raiders D/ST allows 30 points in Week 4
items.desc: The Raiders D/ST allowed 30 points while notching two sacks in a 30-27 loss to the Chiefs in Week 4.
items.impact: Las Vegas struggled to contain the Kansas City rushing attack as they allowed Kenneth Walker III to roll up 177 yards and two touchdowns. The Raiders will look to bounce back against the Patriots in Week 5.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Matt Gay makes four FGs in Week 4
items.desc: Matt Gay made all four of his field-goal attempts and added one extra point in a 30-27 loss to the Chiefs in Week 4.
items.impact: Gay hit field goals from 32, 48, 44, and 48 yards out in the close loss. The veteran has now made all 10 of his field goals in 2026. He will take on the Patriots in Week 5.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Ian Thomas finds the end zone in Week 4
items.desc: Ian Thomas caught both of his targets for 32 yards and a touchdown in a 30-27 loss to the Chiefs in Week 4.
items.impact: Thomas found the end zone on a 27-yard pass from Kirk Cousins in the first quarter. The veteran will continue to be the third tight end behind Brock Bowers and Michael Mayer, which will limit his upside in fantasy leagues. He will face the Patriots in Week 5.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Michael Mayer goes for 82 yards in Week 4
items.desc: Michael Mayer caught eight of his 10 targets for 82 yards in a 30-27 loss to the Chiefs in Week 4.
items.impact: Mayer finished second on the team in receiving behind only Brock Bowers. His involvement alongside Bowers has been encouraging as Mayer caught a touchdown back in Week 3. Mayer is worth a look as a tight end streamer in deeper fantasy leagues going forward. He will face the Patriots in Week 5.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Brock Bowers finds the end zone in Week 4
items.desc: Brock Bowers caught six of his 11 targets for 86 yards and a touchdown in a 30-27 loss to the Chiefs in Week 4.
items.impact: Bowers turned in a second straight dominant game for the Raiders. He found the end zone on a 20-yard pass from Kirk Cousins in the fourth quarter. Bowers now has 16 catches for 202 yards and two touchdowns in two games. He will be a top fantasy TE option in Week 5 vs. the Patriots.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Jalen Nailor leaves Week 4 with a concussion
items.desc: Jalen Nailor was not targeted in a 30-27 loss to the Chiefs in Week 4.
items.impact: Nailor suffered a concussion during the first half and did not return. He will now enter the league's concussion protocol as he attempts to get cleared in time for a Week 5 matchup against the Patriots.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Tre Tucker goes for 44 yards in Week 4
items.desc: Tre Tucker caught four of his eight targets for 44 yards in a 30-27 loss to the Chiefs in Week 4.
items.impact: Tucker tied for third on the team with his eight targets in a game where Kirk Cousins attempted 52 passes. Tucker has been a solid fantasy option this season, posting 15 catches for 233 yards and a touchdown through four games. He will be a fantasy flex in Week 5 vs. the Patriots.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Mike Washington Jr. runs for 18 yards in Week 4
items.desc: Mike Washington Jr. carried the ball nine times for 18 yards and lost a yard on his lone catch in a 30-27 loss to the Chiefs in Week 4.
items.impact: Washington couldn't replicate his big game in Week 3, where he ran for 54 yards and a touchdown on just five carries. The rookie runner remains a solid fantasy handcuff in all leagues in case something happens to Ashton Jeanty. Washington will face the Patriots in Week 5.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Ashton Jeanty runs for 58 yards in Week 4
items.desc: Ashton Jeanty carried the ball 15 times for 58 yards and caught six of his eight targets for 68 yards in a 30-27 loss to the Chiefs in Week 4.
items.impact: Jeanty salvaged another tough day on the ground with his work in the passing game. He briefly left the game with what appeared to be an ankle injury but was able to return to action, although it is concerning considering he has been dealing with an ankle issue since the preseason. The second-year running back has been held to 58 or fewer rushing yards in three straight games but continues to see the majority of the backfield work in Las Vegas. He will be a solid RB1 in Week 5 vs. the Patriots.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Kirk Cousins throws two TDs in Week 4 loss
items.desc: Kirk Cousins completed 31 of his 52 passes for 365 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception in a 30-27 loss to the Chiefs in Week 4. He also completed a two-point conversion pass to Cody White.
items.impact: Cousins put up big numbers in the close loss but he couldn't quite knock off the Chiefs. His touchdown passes went to Brock Bowers and Ian Thomas in the contest. Cousins has looked reinvigorated for the Raiders this season, throwing for 1,026 yards, 11 touchdowns, and four interceptions through four games. He will be a high-end QB2 in Week 5 vs. the Patriots.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Chiefs D/ST allows 27 points in Week 4
items.desc: The Chiefs D/ST allowed 27 points while forcing two turnovers in a 30-27 win over the Raiders in Week 4.
items.impact: Kansas City struggled to slow down the Raiders on offense but they managed to hold on in the close win. They intercepted Kirk Cousins once and recovered a Dareke Young fumble in the game. Kansas City will be on bye in Week 5 before a Week 6 matchup against the Chargers.
